title: Claim does not balance on one side
notes: The vendor side reports the pre-sequestration amount 70.40 in CLP04 while its line keeps the 1.41 sequestration adjustment, so its claim does not balance; the MAC side reports 68.99. Follows the rule-gap cause (the 835 generator omits an adjustment from the claim total).

imbalance.detail: vendor.835 is deliberately unbalanced: CLP03 100.00 minus CLP04 70.40 is 29.60, but the claim's adjustments total 31.01 (CO-45 12.00, CO-253 1.41, PR-2 17.60). Line balance and BPR02 = sum of CLP04 hold on both sides; mac.835 balances fully.
